Name: JP's Utility Machines - Fertilizer Maker
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#00ff00][u][center]Fertilizer Maker[/center][/u][/color][/size][/i][/b]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][b][i]Who needs super advanced knowledge to make fertilizer when you can let a machine do it for you?[/i][/b][/size][/color]


[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]In Pierre's store you can find this super special machine that can produce any of the 3 fertilizers (but only up to intermediate quality). [/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]When you place the required amount of material, the machine will continue to create fertilizer infinitely or until you change the production material. A different material is required to create a different type of fertilizer. [/size][/font]
[/list]
[color=#ff0000][size=5][i]Its operation is quite simple and uncomplicated, I hope you find it useful and enjoy it![/i][/size][/color]

[b][i][color=#ff7700][size=6]You can make and publish your translations without asking for permission![/size][/color][/i][/b]
